# cloudminator_secret (Resource)

A secret stored in the platform's regional vault. `data` is write-only: the platform never returns it, so Terraform only detects changes made through Terraform. Changing `data` writes a new version in place.

~> `data` is stored in the Terraform state. Protect your state accordingly.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "db_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

resource "cloudminator_secret" "db" {
  name = "app-db"
  data = {
    username = "app"
    password = var.db_password
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name. Not unique.

### Optional

- `data` (Map of String, Sensitive) Secret key/value material.
- `org` (String) Organization slug. Defaults to the provider's `org`. Changing it forces a new resource.
- `project` (String) Project slug. Defaults to the provider's `project` (or `default`). Changing it forces a new resource.
- `region` (String) Region of the vault holding the secret. Fixed for life.
- `tags` (Map of String) Key/value tags. Used by attribute-based access control, so a change can be denied if the new tags fall outside the caller's scope.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Server-assigned secret id (`secret-…`).
- `path` (String) Vault path assigned by the platform.
- `phase` (String) Lifecycle phase reported by the platform (`Running`, `Stopped`, …).
- `simulated` (Boolean) True when the platform served this from a simulated (non-production) backend: nothing real exists behind it.
- `version` (Number) Current version of the material.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a secret by organization, project and secret id.
# The platform never returns secret material, so an imported secret has no data
# until Terraform writes it (which creates a new version).
terraform import cloudminator_secret.db acme/default/secret-0123456789abcdef01234567
```
